question: What is the grading scale at ACity for Business, Communication Arts and IT students?
answer:

• 80-100% → A (4.0) — Excellent
• 75-79% → B+ (3.5) — Very Good
• 70-74% → B (3.0) — Good

• 60-64% → C (2.0) — Fair

• 50-54% → D (1.0) — Weak Pass
• Below 50% → Fail (0)

question: What is the attendance requirement to sit for exams at ACity?
answer:
To qualify to sit for end-of-semester examinations at ACity, you must:
1. Achieve at least 75% attendance of contact hours for each course
2. Complete all assignments
3. Complete the mid-semester examination

A student who fails to meet the 75% attendance threshold will be barred from writing the end-of-semester exam and will be deemed to have failed that course. They must either repeat or drop the course.

question: What CGPA do I need to progress from one level to the next at ACity?
answer:
Progression requirements at ACity:

Level 100 to 200:
• Pass all courses taken
• Minimum CGPA of 1.5 or CWA of 50%
• Must not have failed more than 6 credits in the academic year
• No failed course can be a pre-requisite to Level 200

Level 200 to 300 and 300 to 400:
• Minimum CGPA of 1.5 or CWA of 50%
• Accumulate at least 24 credits for the current year
• Must not have failed more than 9 credits in the academic year, or more than 12 credits across different academic years

question: What happens if I fail too many courses at ACity? Can I be dismissed?
answer:
ACity dismissal and repeat policy:
• If you fail 10-12 credits, you are allowed to repeat the failed courses.
• A Level 100 student who fails a total of 12 credits registered for an academic year (in one or both semesters) will be DISMISSED for poor academic performance.
• A dismissed student may re-apply for admission into a DIFFERENT programme the following academic year.
• Further withdrawal may occur for other academic or disciplinary reasons as stated in the Student Handbook.

Contact registry@acity.edu.gh if you are concerned about your academic standing.
keywords: dismissed, withdrawal, fail, academic probation, repeat, 12 credits

question: What are the requirements to graduate from ACity?
answer:
To graduate from Academic City University, you must:
1. Pass all core courses for your programme
2. Meet inter-faculty (universal) course requirements
3. Accumulate a minimum of 120 credits
4. Attain a minimum CGPA of 1.5 or CWA of 50%
5. Maintain acceptable moral conduct at the university
6. Clear all financial obligations to the university

Contact registry@acity.edu.gh for graduation applications and clearance.

question: What are the rules in the ACity hostel?
answer:
Key ACity Hostel Rules:

1. Respect: Noise must be kept low. No harassment. Disrespect toward staff or fellow students leads to disciplinary action.
2. Alcohol, drugs, and smoking are PROHIBITED in the hostel.
3. Cooking is prohibited beyond reheating food using the rice cooker provided in the kitchen.
4. Appliances NOT allowed in bedrooms: mini stoves, toasters, heaters. Allowed: laptops, small radios, lamps, fans, mini-fridges, microwaves, TVs, irons.
5. Non-resident visitors must leave by 9pm. Violation leads to a hostel ban.
6. Students hosting non-residents after 9am will receive a warning from the Dean of Students.
7. Rooms cannot be changed once allocated.
8. During school breaks, all residents must vacate the hostel.
9. No subletting of rooms to other people.
10. Valid health insurance is required before moving into the hostel.
11. CCTV cameras are in place — tampering leads to suspension.

question: What is plagiarism, collusion and cheating at ACity and what are the consequences?
answer:
ACity defines academic integrity violations as:

• PLAGIARISM: Using someone else's work without proper citation or attribution — submitting it as your own.
• COLLUSION: Two or more students submitting individual work that is so similar it could only have occurred by working together on the solution. All parties are equally guilty.
• CHEATING: One person doing the work and others using that work in their answer. The copier is primarily guilty.

Consequences per the penalty table:
• First offense: Cancellation of the assignment or exam.
• Severe or repeated offenses: Suspension.

Important: Do not leave your work unprotected (physically or digitally) — if others copy it, you may face collusion allegations even if you were not aware.
keywords: plagiarism, cheating, collusion, academic integrity, copy, turnitin

question: What clubs and societies are available at ACity?
answer:
ACity strongly supports extra-curricular activities and student development through clubs and societies. Students have freedom of association, but only clubs approved and recognized by the university at the start of each academic year may use university facilities.

To establish a club at ACity, a club must:

question: Is there an internship requirement at ACity?
answer:
Yes. ACity requires all students to complete a mandatory industrial attachment/internship as part of their programme.

Key details:
• Duration: Typically 2 months
• Grading: Internship Report = 60% of final grade, Supervisor Evaluation = 40%
• Students write a report using guidelines from the Career Services department
• Supervisors are sent an electronic evaluation form
• Allowances: Companies are free to pay or not pay — ACity has no policy requiring companies to pay interns
• Location and company selection matters for career development

Contact Career Services for placement guidance and report guidelines.
keywords: internship, industrial attachment, practical training, work experience, placement
